responsibility: This implementation module provides the concrete single-character output wrapper by forwarding `Write` to `FIO.WriteChar` and `WriteLn` to `FIO.WriteLine`. Its role is deliberately small and stable: it is the `CHAR`-level bridge into the core file I/O subsystem that other modules, notably `String.mod`, call when emitting text one character at a time.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the CHAR pair: unlike `gcc/m2/gm2-libs/CHAR.def`, it contains the actual wrappers that call `FIO.WriteChar` and `FIO.WriteLine`.
